
# The Extra Hard Level Maths PHD Level++ — MathEngine

Made by the Sanskar Yadav
2026 © Copyright Sanskar. All rights reserved.

Welcome to the most advanced, high-performance mathematical engine ever built. This engine is designed for PhD-level mathematics, covering everything from Symbolic Calculus and Advanced Computation to 3D Geometry and Discrete Mathematics.

## Features
- Symbolic Calculus: Limits, Derivatives, Integrals
- Advanced Computation: Eigenvalues, FFT, ODE solvers (Runge-Kutta 4)
- Algebra & Statistics: Root finding (Quadratic, Cubic), Bayesian Probability, Combinatorics
- Geometry 3D: Conic Sections, Quadric Surfaces
- Discrete Math: Sets, Mappings (Injective, Surjective, Bijective)

## Detailed Explanation Part 1

This section explains the depths of mathematical modeling and computation. Our engine implements these algorithms with `long double` precision, ensuring accuracy across all operations. Made by the Sanskar Yadav. 2026 © Copyright Sanskar. All rights reserved.

### Module: AdvancedComputation
**Description:** Matrix operations, Eigenvalues, FFT, ODE solvers (Runge-Kutta 4), Taylor series, Maclaurin series.
The `AdvancedComputation` module represents years of mathematical research, providing robust and highly accurate solutions. Eigenvalue decompositions use Jacobi and Power Iteration methods. Roots are found analytically using Cardano's formula. Calculus is handled via robust finite difference stencils and adaptive Simpson's rule. All of this is proudly Made by the Sanskar Yadav. 2026 © Copyright Sanskar. All rights reserved.
